#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Assemble the platform deploy token from staged auth fragments.

The v2 deploy tooling expects the original per-service auth fragments to be
re-assembled into a single deploy token. This reads the plain-text fragment
files in .staging/auth_parts/ and concatenates them in a fixed, documented
service order.

Usage: python3 build_deploy_token.py [--parts-dir DIR] [--out FILE]
"""

import argparse
import pathlib
import sys

# Fixed service order for the platform deploy token.
SERVICE_ORDER = [
    "payments-gateway",
    "payments-notifier",
    "payments-scheduler",
    "payments-ledger",
]


def part_filename(service):
    """Fragment file name for a service, matching the .part convention."""
    if service == "payments-notifier":
        # The notifier fragment was staged under its short service name.
        return "notifier.part"
    return f"{service}.part"


def assemble(parts_dir):
    """Return the assembled deploy token, or raise if a fragment is missing."""
    fragments = []
    for service in SERVICE_ORDER:
        path = pathlib.Path(parts_dir) / part_filename(service)
        if not path.is_file():
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"missing fragment for {service}: {path}")
        fragments.append(path.read_text().strip())
    return "".join(fragments)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument(
        "--parts-dir",
        default=".staging/auth_parts",
        help="directory containing staged .part fragments",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--out",
        default=".staging/deploy_token.txt",
        help="path of the assembled deploy token",
    )
    args = parser.parse_args()

    token = assemble(args.parts_dir)
    out = pathlib.Path(args.out)
    out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    out.write_text(token + "\n")
    print(f"assembled deploy token -> {out} ({len(token)} chars)")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Assemble the platform deploy token from staged auth fragments.

The v2 deploy tooling expects the original per-service auth fragments to be
re-assembled into a single deploy token. This reads the plain-text fragment
files in .staging/auth_parts/ and concatenates them in a fixed, documented
service order.

Usage: python3 build_deploy_token.py [--parts-dir DIR] [--out FILE]
"""

import argparse
import pathlib
import sys

# Fixed service order for the platform deploy token.
SERVICE_ORDER = [
    "payments-gateway",
    "payments-notifier",
    "payments-scheduler",
    "payments-ledger",
]


def part_filename(service):
    """Fragment file name for a service, matching the .part convention."""
    if service == "payments-notifier":
        # The notifier fragment was staged under its short service name.
        return "notifier.part"
    return f"{service}.part"


def assemble(parts_dir):
    """Return the assembled deploy token, or raise if a fragment is missing."""
    fragments = []
    for service in SERVICE_ORDER:
        path = pathlib.Path(parts_dir) / part_filename(service)
        if not path.is_file():
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"missing fragment for {service}: {path}")
        fragments.append(path.read_text().strip())
    return "".join(fragments)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument(
        "--parts-dir",
        default=".staging/auth_parts",
        help="directory containing staged .part fragments",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--out",
        default=".staging/deploy_token.txt",
        help="path of the assembled deploy token",
    )
    args = parser.parse_args()

    token = assemble(args.parts_dir)
    out = pathlib.Path(args.out)
    out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    out.write_text(token + "\n")
    print(f"assembled deploy token -> {out} ({len(token)} chars)")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

"""Assemble the platform deploy token from staged auth fragments.

The v2 deploy tooling expects the original per-service auth fragments to be
re-assembled into a single deploy token. This reads the plain-text fragment
files in .staging/auth_parts/ and concatenates them in a fixed, documented

Usage: python3 build_deploy_token.py [--parts-dir DIR] [--out FILE]

import argparse
import pathlib
import sys

# Fixed service order for the platform deploy token.
SERVICE_ORDER = [
    "payments-gateway",
    "payments-notifier",
    "payments-scheduler",
    "payments-ledger",
]


def part_filename(service):
    """Fragment file name for a service, matching the .part convention."""
    if service == "payments-notifier":
        # The notifier fragment was staged under its short service name.
        return "notifier.part"
    return f"{service}.part"


def assemble(parts_dir):
    """Return the assembled deploy token, or raise if a fragment is missing."""
    fragments = []
    for service in SERVICE_ORDER:
        path = pathlib.Path(parts_dir) / part_filename(service)
        if not path.is_file():
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"missing fragment for {service}: {path}")
        fragments.append(path.read_text().strip())
    return "".join(fragments)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument(
        "--parts-dir",
        default=".staging/auth_parts",
        help="directory containing staged .part fragments",
    )

        "--out",
        default=".staging/deploy_token.txt",
        help="path of the assembled deploy token",
    )
    args = parser.parse_args()

    token = assemble(args.parts_dir)
    out = pathlib.Path(args.out)
    out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    out.write_text(token + "\n")
    print(f"assembled deploy token -> {out} ({len(token)} chars)")
    return 0

"""Assemble the platform deploy token from staged auth fragments.

The v2 deploy tooling expects the original per-service auth fragments to be
re-assembled into a single deploy token. This reads the plain-text fragment
files in .staging/auth_parts/ and concatenates them in a fixed, documented
service order.

Usage: python3 build_deploy_token.py [--parts-dir DIR] [--out FILE]
"""

import argparse
import pathlib
import sys

# Fixed service order for the platform deploy token.
SERVICE_ORDER = [
    "payments-gateway",
    "payments-notifier",
    "payments-scheduler",
    "payments-ledger",
]


def part_filename(service):
    """Fragment file name for a service, matching the .part convention."""
    if service == "payments-notifier":
        # The notifier fragment was staged under its short service name.
        return "notifier.part"
    return f"{service}.part"


def assemble(parts_dir):
    """Return the assembled deploy token, or raise if a fragment is missing."""
    fragments = []
    for service in SERVICE_ORDER:
        path = pathlib.Path(parts_dir) / part_filename(service)
        if not path.is_file():
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"missing fragment for {service}: {path}")
        fragments.append(path.read_text().strip())
    return "".join(fragments)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument(
        "--parts-dir",
        default=".staging/auth_parts",
        help="directory containing staged .part fragments",
    )

        "--out",
        default=".staging/deploy_token.txt",
        help="path of the assembled deploy token",
    )
    args = parser.parse_args()

    token = assemble(args.parts_dir)
    out = pathlib.Path(args.out)
    out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    out.write_text(token + "\n")
    print(f"assembled deploy token -> {out} ({len(token)} chars)")
    return 0

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Assemble the platform deploy token from staged auth fragments.

The v2 deploy tooling expects the original per-service auth fragments to be
re-assembled into a single deploy token. This reads the plain-text fragment
files in .staging/auth_parts/ and concatenates them in a fixed, documented
service order.

Usage: python3 build_deploy_token.py [--parts-dir DIR] [--out FILE]
"""

import argparse
import pathlib
import sys

# Fixed service order for the platform deploy token.
SERVICE_ORDER = [
    "payments-gateway",
    "payments-notifier",
    "payments-scheduler",
    "payments-ledger",
]


def part_filename(service):
    """Fragment file name for a service, matching the .part convention."""
    if service == "payments-notifier":
        # The notifier fragment was staged under its short service name.
        return "notifier.part"
    return f"{service}.part"


def assemble(parts_dir):
    """Return the assembled deploy token, or raise if a fragment is missing."""
    fragments = []
    for service in SERVICE_ORDER:
        path = pathlib.Path(parts_dir) / part_filename(service)
        if not path.is_file():
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"missing fragment for {service}: {path}")
        fragments.append(path.read_text().strip())
    return "".join(fragments)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument(
        "--parts-dir",
        default=".staging/auth_parts",
        help="directory containing staged .part fragments",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--out",
        default=".staging/deploy_token.txt",
        help="path of the assembled deploy token",
    )
    args = parser.parse_args()

    token = assemble(args.parts_dir)
    out = pathlib.Path(args.out)
    out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    out.write_text(token + "\n")
    print(f"assembled deploy token -> {out} ({len(token)} chars)")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
